label: Welcome to It's a Plan
proNote: Available in Cloud and Self-hosted Pro.

dashboards.title: Build your own dashboards
dashboards.body: Make a dashboard for each thing you track and pick its widgets: issue counts, breakdowns, burn-up, throughput, activity and agent runs.

workItems.title: Every task is an issue
workItems.body: See the same issues as a kanban board, a table, a timeline or a calendar by month, week or day. Save the filters you use as a view.

initiatives.title: Group issues under one goal
initiatives.body: An initiative collects the issues that move a larger goal. Its progress and health update as those issues move.

cycles.title: Plan work in time boxes
cycles.body: A cycle is a fixed period the team plans its issues into. When it ends, move the unfinished issues to the next one.

documents.title: Write next to the work
documents.body: Keep specs and decisions in documents. Link them to issues and initiatives, discuss them in comments and restore any earlier revision.

notes.title: Sketch ideas on a board
notes.body: A note board is a freeform canvas for sticky notes. Keep a board to yourself or share it with the project.

agents.title: Hand work to an AI agent
agents.body: Assign an issue to an agent or ask it in the chat. It works with the tools and skills you give it and reports what it did.

schedules.title: Run agents on a schedule
schedules.body: Start an agent at a set time or when an issue enters a state. Pro also starts one when an issue is created or assigned, a label is added or a comment is posted, only for the issues that match a filter.

workflows.name: Workflows
workflows.title: Chain agents into a workflow
workflows.body: A workflow passes work from one agent to the next. It starts by hand, on a schedule, on an issue event or from a webhook, and a step can send the work back for fixes.

portal.name: Support portal
portal.title: Take requests from outside the team
portal.body: Put a form on your site or give clients a portal. Each request becomes an issue, and the sender gets an email when someone replies.

budgets.name: AI budgets
budgets.title: Cap what agents spend
budgets.body: Set a limit on model spending for the whole workspace, a team, a project or each person, per day, week or month. Once a budget is spent, agents start no new runs.

analytics.name: AI analytics
analytics.title: See where agent time and money go
analytics.body: Break agent runs down by person, trigger, schedule and workflow, with run time and the tool calls that failed.

audit.name: Audit log
audit.title: Know who did what
audit.body: The audit log records changes to people, settings and data, and every sign-in. Export it when you need it.
